title: 25Oct-Felicitation - RI President Dr Bharat Pandya
summary: On 25th October, President Rtn Bernhard Steinruecke attended the Celebration and Felicitation Ceremony of honouring RI President 2028-29 Rtn Dr. Bharat & Madhavi Pandya from 10 am onwards at Hotel Sahara Star.
description: On 25th October, President Rtn Bernhard Steinruecke attended the Celebration and Felicitation Ceremony of honouring RI President 2028-29 Rtn Dr. Bharat & Madhavi Pandya from 10 am onwards at Hotel Sahara Star. As per hi, “It was a privilege to be there and meet Siloo and Shirish”. The program included Opening Remarks by Convenor Rtn T N Raju Subramanian, Welcome Address by DG Rtn Rajan Dua and DG Rtn Nilesh Jaywant (RID3142) and addresses on "View from the Other side", "As I Saw It", Panel Discussions, "My View", "Exceed Expectations", "The Bharat I Know", Message from PRIP Rtn Raja Saboo, "The Power Within Us", Felicitation of RI President 2028-29, "Not Me, WE RI President 2028-29 Rtn Dr Bharat Pandya" and ending with vote of thanks and lunch.
